title: Accenture Technology Vision 2022: Meet Me in the Metaverse: The continuum of technology and experience reshaping business
notes: Four trends, numbered Trend 01-04. Quotes are the one-sentence trend descriptions on the Introduction page 'Our Four Technology Trends for 2022'. Published date: PDF created 2022-03-15, first Wayback capture 2022-03-16. The file `_acnmedia/PDF-174/Accenture-Tech-Vision-2022.pdf` (also downloaded) is a French executive summary, not the English report.

entries.label: WebMe
entries.quote: The internet is being reimagined as metaverse and Web3 efforts transform the underpinning and operation of the virtual world.
entries.subject: Metaverse and Web3
entries.note: Edition-level horizon: the Introduction describes the 'Metaverse Continuum' as 'poised to revolutionize life and enterprise in the next decade.' Printed subtitle: 'Putting the Me in Metaverse'. Survey: 71% of global executives state that the metaverse will have a positive impact on their organizations, with 42% believing it will be breakthrough or transformational (no horizon).

entries.label: Programmable World
entries.quote: Control, customization, and automation are being enmeshed into the world around us, making the physical as programmable as the digital.
entries.subject: Programmable physical environments (5G, ambient computing, AR, smart materials)
entries.note: Edition-level horizon: the Introduction describes the 'Metaverse Continuum' as 'poised to revolutionize life and enterprise in the next decade.' Printed subtitle: 'Our Planet, Personalized'. Present-tense survey: 74% of executives report IoT/edge devices deployed significantly or exponentially increased.

entries.label: The Unreal
entries.quote: As AI-generated data and synthetic content convincingly mimic what is “real,” authenticity is the new north star.
entries.subject: Synthetic media and AI authenticity
entries.metric: global consumers who think the number of times they interact with AI or AI-generated content will increase
entries.note: Edition-level horizon: the Introduction describes the 'Metaverse Continuum' as 'poised to revolutionize life and enterprise in the next decade.' Printed subtitle: 'Making Synthetic, Authentic'. Consumer survey figure, not executive.

entries.label: Computing the Impossible
entries.quote: A new generation of computers are solving some of the world’s most intractable problems, leading to one of the biggest technological disruptions of our time.
entries.subject: Quantum, biologically inspired and high performance computing
entries.note: Edition-level horizon: the Introduction describes the 'Metaverse Continuum' as 'poised to revolutionize life and enterprise in the next decade.' Printed subtitle: 'New Machines, New Possibilities'. Survey: 69% of global executives report quantum computing will have a breakthrough or transformational impact on their organizations in the future (no horizon).
